name: What finish should I expect after drywall mudding?
description: Expect a paint-ready wall that looks smooth in normal light, though stronger lighting will reveal whether the finish was done carefully.

mainEntity.name: What finish should I expect after drywall mudding?

acceptedAnswer.text: A smoother finish is better if the wall will be in a bright room or under strong side lighting, because those conditions highlight every seam and imperfection. In low-light areas or utility spaces, a simpler finish may be acceptable if the surface is still flat and paint-ready.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a paint-ready wall that looks smooth in normal light, though stronger lighting will reveal whether the finish was done carefully.
